title: skillevaluation test case result
description: Per-case A/B result emitted by a conforming runner.

case_name.description: Echo of the case's `name` from eval.yaml.

expectation_results.comment: Inlined as #/$defs/judgeResult so a naive jsonschema.validate resolves OFFLINE: resolving judge-result.schema.json by its absolute $id would need a network fetch, and would pull whatever is on the default branch rather than the version in hand. The standalone judge-result schema stays canonical for consumers that load it by $id (resources.build_registry()).

judgeResult.$comment: Mirror of judge-result.schema.json (kept in sync) — inlined for offline validation.

expectation.description: Echo of the expectation text being graded.

passed.description: Did the agent's response satisfy this expectation?

reason.description: 1–3 sentence prose explanation grounded in observable agent behavior.

score.description: Optional confidence in `passed`. Not used by run-level aggregation.

errored.description: True when the judge transport itself failed (API down, timeout) — the expectation is UNGRADED, not failed. Runners MUST roll this up into the arm's `errored` flag so the case classifies as outcome 'error' and is excluded from aggregate lift. See spec/llm-judge.md edge-case table.

passed.description: All assertions passed for this arm.

task_attempted.description: Did the agent meaningfully engage with the task? Drives the apples-to-oranges skip rule.

errored.description: Did this arm fail to execute (transient API failure, sandbox crash)?

True when the validator produced no verdict — the grader broke (non-binary undeclared exit code), timed out, or could not be spawned. The check is UNGRADED, not failed. Runners MUST roll this up into the arm's `errored` flag so the case classifies as outcome 'error' and is excluded from aggregate lift. See spec/runner-contract.md.
